advisory.summary: Panic in archive/zip (*Reader).Open when processing archives containing entries with names consisting only of slashes or '..' elements. Affects Go 1.16.0-1.16.9 and 1.17.0-1.17.2. Fixed in Go 1.16.10, 1.17.3. Aliases: CVE-2021-41772.

acquisition.notes: Service built with a vulnerable Go toolchain (1.17.1) that accepts ZIP file uploads and calls (*zip.Reader).Open on the uploaded archive. The vulnerable symbol is reachable from an HTTP handler. However, triggering the panic requires an attacker-supplied archive with a specially crafted entry name (all slashes or '..' only) — a precondition that depends on external input format constraints not automatically satisfiable by the current environment. The service is also deployable on patched Go toolchains where the vuln is absent. NOTE: GO-2021-0264 affects the Go stdlib (archive/zip), not a separately-versioned module; the repro models a service compiled on a vulnerable Go version. Advisory verified against osv.dev on 2026-06-02.

expected_verdict.label: reasoned_exploitable
expected_verdict.rationale: The vulnerable (*zip.Reader).Open symbol is reachable from an HTTP handler that processes user-supplied ZIP uploads on an affected Go toolchain version. The taint path from ingress to vulnerable symbol is traceable statically. However, confirming exploitability requires: (a) the test environment uses a vulnerable Go toolchain build, and (b) a crafted archive with pathological entry names is injected as the upload. Neither precondition is satisfiable without toolchain pinning and controlled test-input delivery, so analysis stops at 'reachable but unconfirmed'. The completion status is stopped_capability (not environment_unavailable) because the limitation is sandbox capability, not environment availability. Advisory verified against osv.dev on 2026-06-02.
